scope: saved n64_w4_8 artifacts only; offline integer algebra; no solver/reduction/kernel

interpretation.dimension_reason: f invertible mod q implies invertible over Q; y=f^-1*g*z with z restricted to 58 core coordinates
interpretation.prefix_spans_short_subspace: 58 exact-identity rows have core rank 58 mod q, hence are independent over Q and span this graph
interpretation.same_tail_rotation_differences: differences of two correct same-tail rotations satisfy f*y=g*z and z_P=z_T=0; they lie in this prefix span
interpretation.tail_projection_consequence: same-tail correct rotations differ only within the first-58-row span and have the same orthogonal projection onto the final 32 or 40 GSO dimensions
interpretation.candidate_count_caution: kernel target submission does not enumerate all golden rotations; these data store one raw candidate for each of 8 golden tails per complete trial; Slicer can in principle return multiple candidates per target
